headline: Health department closes 21Lux apartments outdoor pool
title: Health closure: 21Lux Apts - Outdoor Pool
why_it_matters: 21Lux Apts outdoor pool at 204 W 2100 S closed Oct. 6; Sept. 29 inspection cited loose grab rails, missing skimmer weir, broken restroom sink, no soap or towels. Not reopened.

headline: Health department shuts Los Panchitos food truck over handwashing violations
title: Health closure: Los Panchitos #Us95Ag
why_it_matters: Los Panchitos food truck at 3232 S 400 E had its permit suspended Oct. 7 after 8 critical violations. The truck had no soap or hand-drying provision, and employees were preparing food without proper handwashing; it has not reopened.

headline: Artesian Springs Apartments pool in Murray closed by health department
title: Health closure: Artesian Springs Apts - North W/P #2
why_it_matters: The Artesian Springs Apartments north pool at 4197 S Main St, Murray, was closed Oct. 7 and has not reopened. The only inspection report provided is from June 23 and lists non-critical issues (missing skimmer weirs and check valves, no operation plan, no soap in a shower), so the closure reason is not stated.

headline: Murray apartment complex hot tub closed over low chlorine
title: Health closure: Current Apts - W/P
why_it_matters: The Current Apts hot tub at 4994 S Commerce Dr in Murray was closed Oct. 5 after a follow-up inspection found free chlorine below 1 ppm and a malfunctioning ORP controller; it was the facility's first permit suspension within a year. It reopened Oct. 6.

headline: Taylorsville mobile home park indoor pool shut over extreme chlorine levels
title: Health closure: Majestic Meadows Mhp - Indoor W/P
why_it_matters: The Majestic Meadows mobile home park indoor pool at 4580 S 1055 W was closed Oct. 8 after inspectors measured chlorine at 50-75 ppm, far above the 10 ppm limit, and found no registered pool operator on staff. It was the second suspension within a year, carrying a minimum 7-day closure, and it has not reopened.

headline: Health department closes Pierpont Apartments pool over unsecured gates
title: Health closure: Pierpont Apts - W/P
why_it_matters: The pool at Pierpont Apts, 315 W Pierpont Ave, was closed Oct. 14, 2026 on a follow-up inspection. Inspectors found gates that were not self-closing or self-latching, a door fob system that appeared not to work, and crash bars on two doors taped open. It is the facility's first permit suspension within a year and the pool has not reopened.

headline: Downtown Lotus Republic apartment pool closed over disinfectant levels
org: Lotus Republic Phase Ii Apts - Pool
title: Health closure: Lotus Republic Phase Ii Apts - Pool
why_it_matters: The Salt Lake County Health Department closed the Lotus Republic Phase II Apts pool at 51 S 300 E on Oct. 15, 2026. The inspection found disinfectant residuals outside the required range and operation that threatened public health, and issued a first permit suspension. The pool has not reopened.

headline: Health department closes Via Apartments outdoor pool over low chlorine
title: Health closure: Via Apartments - Outdoor W/P
why_it_matters: Via Apartments outdoor pool at 3808 S West Temple St was closed Oct. 16, 2026 on a follow-up inspection for free chlorine below required levels and gates not self-closing; first permit suspension within a year. Not reopened.

headline: Lakeside Village Apartments spa closed for excessive chlorine
title: Health closure: Lakeside Village Apts - W/P
why_it_matters: Lakeside Village Apts spa/pool at 1580 W 3940 S was closed Oct. 19 after inspectors found free chlorine above 10 ppm, plus a broken heater thermometer and missing safety signage; first permit suspension within a year. Not reopened.
